title: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Demo site answers The console's systems check report…
asked: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Demo site answers The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:http-demo-site` (service vps, status warn) - What it says: couldn't run: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate (_ssl.c:1011) - How the fix failed: If step 2 shows ACME rate-limit or DNS errors, the reinstall in step 3 won't clear it. DNS is something I can fix through the Hostinger connector, so you still won't have to do it yourself. Details: - The demo deploy pulls the site branch every 2 minutes; if this fails, the pull or the proxy is broken. - http {"url": "https://axf.amberxai.com/", "expect": [200]} How it's fixed by hand: - Check the deploy workflow run on GitHub, then the VPS pull cron (host-update-cron) and the Traefik route for axf.amberxai.com. Rules: - Fix only this check. Change nothing unrelated; never delete data, volumes, containers or other people's files. - Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/). - Code changes go on this worktree's branch only: commit and push the branch, never main, never merge. - When done, refresh the host report: `bash /opt/axf/deploy/console-doctor.sh --report`. - Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it; `changes.mjs step|result last …`). - You may run shell commands on the VPS (you run as root): prefer the smallest, reversible change.

steps.text: Diagnose: no container/route for axf.amberxai.com (only legacy xaf-amberxai), Traefik default cert
Add axf-amberxai nginx container + Traefik labels + 2-min pull cron (install.sh 3a, old xaf left untouched)

result.summary: VPS-only fix: demo site now served at https://axf.amberxai.com (Let's Encrypt, 200). No repo changes. Legacy xaf-amberxai setup still running alongside.
